changeinfo.changes:
• Streamlined the flow when joining the host's game through Party
  • Addressed some rare cases where game joining would fail
  • Game Mode type now displays at the beginning of every match
  • The Host now has more time to review end of match XP update in Party games
  • Directly hitting and killing an enemy with the Hedgehog grenade will now correctly credit the user with a kill
  • Enabled stat posting to www.myresistance.net
